rules.rule: No public site imports another public site.
No public site imports Central Admin or Python/backend/infrastructure internals.
No Central Admin imports public-site source.
Shared TypeScript packages never import app source and never own public visual/theme/assets/current-site state.
bp_ports depends inward on bp_domain only among first-party layers.
bp_application may depend on bp_domain + bp_ports, never concrete adapters/entrypoints.
API and Worker entrypoints never import each other.
FastAPI-generated OpenAPI is derived diagnostic output only; canonical file remains DOC-15 RC12 YAML.
SQLAlchemy metadata/create_all never becomes DOC-08 DDL authority.
Celery/broker internals never redefine DOC-18 jobs/queues/retry/dedupe/lease/DLQ semantics.
